panels.title: Workers and Running Assignments
panels.description: Current worker instances (heartbeat within 90 seconds), with one indented line per live realtime, backfill-shard or drain assignment. Workers become Stale after 30 seconds without a heartbeat and disappear after 90 seconds. Idle workers have no child rows. Worker capacity is allocated units / total units; task rows show reported progress or attempt count. Elapsed is time since the recorded start, including retries. Current state refreshes every 10 seconds, independently of the dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH current_workers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT worker_id, capacity_units, heartbeat_at,
    CASE WHEN lifecycle_state <> 'active' THEN lifecycle_state
         WHEN heartbeat_at < now() - interval '30 seconds' THEN 'Stale'
         ELSE 'Healthy' END AS health
  FROM ingester.workers
  WHERE heartbeat_at > now() - interval '90 seconds'
), assignments AS (
  SELECT p.lease_owner AS worker_id, 'Realtime' AS kind,
    p.strategy_key AS task, p.strategy_key AS identity,
    p.observed_state || ' / ' || p.health_status AS state,
    2::bigint AS units, p.heartbeat_at, p.source_watermark,
    p.started_at, ''::text AS progress
  FROM ingester.profiles p JOIN current_workers w ON w.worker_id = p.lease_owner
  WHERE p.desired_state = 'running' AND p.lease_expires_at > now()
  UNION ALL
  SELECT j.assigned_worker_id, 'Backfill',
    j.strategy_key || ' · ' || COALESCE(j.shard_key, left(j.job_id::text, 8)),
    j.job_id::text, j.status, j.allocation_units::bigint,
    j.heartbeat_at, NULL::timestamptz, j.started_at,
    'Attempt ' || j.attempt || '/' || j.max_attempts
  FROM ingester.backfill_jobs j JOIN current_workers w ON w.worker_id = j.assigned_worker_id
  WHERE j.status IN ('running', 'cancel_requested') AND j.lease_expires_at > now()
  UNION ALL
  SELECT j.assigned_worker_id, 'Drain',
    j.strategy_key || ' · ' || left(j.job_id::text, 8), j.job_id::text,
    j.status, 0::bigint, j.updated_at, NULL::timestamptz, j.started_at,
    j.rows_exported || ' rows · ' || j.objects_published || ' objects · ' || pg_size_pretty(j.bytes_written)
  FROM ingester.drain_jobs j JOIN current_workers w ON w.worker_id = j.assigned_worker_id
  WHERE j.status IN ('running', 'cancel_requested') AND j.lease_expires_at > now()
), display_rows AS (
  SELECT w.worker_id, 0 AS row_order, ''::text AS identity,
    w.worker_id AS label, w.health AS state,
    CASE WHEN count(a.identity) = 0 THEN 'Idle'
         ELSE count(a.identity)::text || CASE WHEN count(a.identity) = 1 THEN ' assignment' ELSE ' assignments' END END AS activity,
    COALESCE(sum(a.units), 0)::text || '/' || w.capacity_units AS stats,
    extract(epoch FROM now() - w.heartbeat_at)::double precision AS heartbeat_age,
    NULL::double precision AS data_age, NULL::double precision AS elapsed
  FROM current_workers w LEFT JOIN assignments a USING (worker_id)
  GROUP BY w.worker_id, w.capacity_units, w.heartbeat_at, w.health
  UNION ALL
  SELECT worker_id, 1, identity, '    ↳ ' || task, state, kind, progress,
    extract(epoch FROM now() - heartbeat_at)::double precision,
    CASE WHEN source_watermark <= now() THEN extract(epoch FROM now() - source_watermark)::double precision END,
    extract(epoch FROM now() - started_at)::double precision
  FROM assignments
)
SELECT label AS "Worker / assignment", state AS "State", activity AS "Activity",
  stats AS "Capacity / progress", heartbeat_age AS "Heartbeat age",
  data_age AS "Data age", elapsed AS "Elapsed"
FROM display_rows ORDER BY worker_id, row_order, activity, identity;

panels.description: Encrypted TCP bytes waiting unread in the kernel divided by the effective SO_RCVBUF reported by the connected orderbook socket. Current is the latest 250ms sample; sampled peak preserves the highest value between Prometheus collections. Sustained values near 100% indicate that the client is not draining the kernel receive queue fast enough.
panels.title: Kernel Receive Queue Pressure

panels.description: Delay between each 250ms socket-pressure probe deadline and when the dedicated CLOB socket runtime actually executes it. This isolates runtime or host scheduling stalls from downstream parsing and persistence latency.
panels.title: Socket Runtime Scheduling Delay

panels.description: Configured Tungstenite read allocation, effective kernel SO_RCVBUF, and the highest sampled unread kernel bytes between Prometheus collections. Tungstenite's value is a read-size optimization, not a fixed overflow queue; SO_RCVBUF is the kernel capacity relevant to TCP backpressure.
panels.title: CLOB Receive Capacity

targets.rawSql: SELECT strategy_key AS "Strategy", COALESCE(lease_owner, 'Unassigned') AS "Worker", desired_state AS "Desired State", observed_state AS "Observed State", desired_generation AS "Desired Generation", applied_generation AS "Applied Generation", heartbeat_at AS "Last Heartbeat", lease_expires_at AS "Lease Expires", CASE WHEN desired_state = 'running' AND (lease_owner IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= now()) THEN 'Unowned' WHEN desired_state = 'running' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at > now() THEN 'Owned' ELSE 'Not requested' END AS "Ownership" FROM ingester.profiles ORDER BY strategy_key LIMIT 100;
